verdict.rationale: Salesforce documents Agentforce agents that act on CRM work: qualifying inbound leads, updating opportunities, closing renewals, and autonomously handling repetitive sales tasks. Agent Builder explicitly accepts natural language to create agents. However, the evidence never directly describes a user typing natural-language commands to operate Sales Cloud records and workflows; that capability is only implied by the agent framing. Missing for 10: explicit docs of a conversational command interface for end users within Sales Cloud, examples of NL commands executing CRM actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
